thesis: PTC Therapeutics (Nasdaq: PTCT). Screen pass (score 70.0) rests on FY2025 net income 682.6M, which came from 998.4M of 9M25 collaboration and license revenue (Novartis license, 10-Q) and is not recurring. TTM (FY25 + 9M26 - 9M25): revenue 1,155.6M, net loss -106.0M, OCF 10.5M, capex 8.4M, FCF 2.1M. 9M26 revenue 990.9M (product 740.3M vs 402.7M, Q3 product 275.9M vs 131.0M; Sephience Q3 181.9M, +20% on Q2; royalties 199.6M, Q3 81.7M incl. Evrysdi). Q3 net loss -51.7M includes 111.0M acquired IPR&D (ST-920 Fabry gene therapy from Sangamo, up to 100M more contingent, BLA planned Q4 2026) and 19.3M debt extinguishment loss. FY26 guide: total revenue 1.29B to 1.32B, product 960M to 990M (raised); implied Q4 product about 220M to 250M, below Q3 276M (secondary source). Close 60.97 x 83,544,284 shares (cover 2026-10-27) = market cap 5,093M = 4.4x TTM revenue, 3.9x FY26 guided revenue midpoint 1,305M. Cash and marketable securities 2,127.9M; 0% convertible notes due 2031 carrying 536.3M; liability for sale of future royalties 2,305.6M (a debt-like claim on royalties); stockholders deficit -191.2M; total liabilities 3,398.9M. Quote 11-13 was 63.49. The price must be judged on forward product growth and breakeven, not trailing earnings: trailing P/E is meaningless.
counterthesis: Strongest countercase: the screen's growth and margin come from a one-time licence payment; underlying GAAP profit is negative and FCF about zero. Royalty sale liability of 2.3B means a large share of Evrysdi royalties is already sold. SBC 70.5M for 9M. Legacy Translarna and Emflaza are eroding (Emflaza 25.1M vs 35.2M) and Translarna includes a Russian government order. Q4 guide implies a sequential step-down. Another 100M contingent and acquired IPR&D charges recur as the company buys pipeline. A negative equity base and rising debt (convertible 550M issued) add dilution and refinancing exposure.
invalidation: Fails if Sephience growth stalls or pricing/reimbursement erodes, cash flow breakeven is missed, royalty-sale obligations bite, or pipeline purchases keep consuming cash.
